thread:
Anya (Product): thinking out loud — prototyping a compact toast tour for first-run instead of the big quickstart banner. goal: less screen real estate, better scannability, still surfaces sample repos and the setup checklist. thoughts?
Mike (Design): i like the reduced chrome. can we keep a persistent micro-checklist somewhere? to avoid users dismissing the tour and losing progress. :thinking_face:
Anya (Product): yes — micro-checklist idea: a tiny progress pill in the header that expands to the full checklist on click. default collapsed.
Jing (Eng): implementation-wise we can do a header pill + slide-over. cheap to build. need to define analytics events (open / complete step / dismiss).
Sam Q (DevEx): callouts: make the sample repos clearly labeled by use-case (chat, retrieval, embeddings). current sample list is confusing to new devs.
Carol (Research): accessibility nits: toast focus management must not trap keyboard. keyboard users should be able to tab out to main content. also screen-reader announcement when toast appears: "Welcome to Redwood — quick setup" and announce checklist progress.
aria-bot: aria-bot automated a11y scan: recommended role="status" for toast + sr-only live message to announce steps.
Mike (Design): copy options for primary CTA — "Try sample repo" vs "Create project from sample". shorter seems better but we should A/B.
Anya (Product): preference for "Create project from sample" — explicit action. but agree A/B with short vs explicit.
Jing (Eng): small tech question: if we include a small repo import flow inline, it may require auth pop and could be too heavy. recommend deep-link to repo import page; keep toast light.
Sam Q (DevEx): agree on deep-link. also add small inline code snippet for the CLI quickstart: `npx redwood init my-app` — but ensure monospace and small copy.
Mike (Design): visual: toast should have 2 actions: primary (create from sample), secondary (see checklist). also an overflow menu with "dismiss for now" and "don't show again".
Carol (Research): accessibility: ensure "don't show again" is reversible in settings. if someone accidentally toggles it, they should be able to reset onboarding.
Anya (Product): good call — add toggle in Settings > Onboarding to reset.
Jing (Eng): logging: add config flag per user and opt-out metric. we'll need backend route to persist preference. low-risk.
Sam Q (DevEx): about sample repos — can we include a short 1-line description + estimated setup time? helps set expectations.
Mike (Design): yes, show 1-line summary + badge "~5 mins" or "~15 mins". keep the card compact.
Carol (Research): color contrast on the time badges needs to be >= 4.5:1 on small text. I flagged one of the current variants as failing.
aria-bot: aria-bot a11y scan result: header pill variant v3 — badge contrast ratio 3.6:1. fails WCAG.
Mike (Design): noted. will iterate colors. prefer using bold text + background swap if necessary.
Anya (Product): decision proposal: ship toast tour + header micro-pill in next canary. deep-link sample repo import. A/B test CTA copy and track conversion to "create project" and "import repo". add settings toggle to reset onboarding. file issues for a11y fixes (badge contrast, sr announcements, keyboard escape).
Jing (Eng): can pick this up for canary week. estimate 3 dev-days + 1 QA day.
Sam Q (DevEx): I'll draft the analytics spec: events: `onboarding.toast_shown`, `onboarding.create_from_sample_clicked`, `onboarding.checklist_opened`, `onboarding.dismissed`, `onboarding.reset_from_settings`.
Carol (Research): I'll run a quick usability check with 5 participants on the prototype once Mike posts it. aim to catch any wording confusion for "create from sample" vs "try sample".
Mike (Design): will post Figma link in this thread later today.
Anya (Product): action items: Mike — updated mockups w/ accessible badge colors. Jing — PR for header pill + toast + backend flag. Sam — analytics events + CLI snippet copy. Carol — usability test plan. I'll create a GH epic and add everyone.
Jing (Eng): one more thought — for private deployments, we should hide repo import CTA and instead show "Add model / Connect infra" suggestions. not sure if toast should be environment-aware.
Anya (Product): good point. make toast variant conditional on deployment type. prod-hosted: sample repos. private/dedicated: infra-first suggestions. add to spec.
Mike (Design): ok will create two variants in Figma.
aria-bot: aria-bot reminder: add `aria-live="polite"` for incremental checklist updates.
Sam Q (DevEx): thanks all — i'll post analytics spec + event names by EOD. :robot_face:
Anya (Product): thanks team! small, measured rollout and watch the conversion funnel. will ping eng-releases for canary schedule. :sparkles:
